HARD CONSTRAINTS: square at least1024px; no text, lettering, glyphs, inscriptions, logo, border, frame or watermark; no extra heads, limbs or fingers; no design borrowed from films, games, anime or comics; no nudity, exposed breasts or explicit gore; no generic glow aura, neon outlines, floating runes or energy ribbons.
rationale: Every illustration must feel 'sangar': dangerous, imposing or awe-inspiring, with the being as the undeniable subject. The owner rejected earlier images that read as an ordinary person, an ordinary animal, an empty landscape, or a calm, cute or decorative portrait. Those outcomes are failures regardless of technical quality.

visual_review.notes: Native 1254px dan pratinjau 200px diperiksa. Satu kepala ular, dua mata, satu tubuh bersisik berliku tanpa kaki/sayap/tanduk, rahang besar memegang kulit berbulu Golden Fleece yang terbaca jelas. Debu dan akar memberi gerak fisik penjagaan aktif; kepala mendominasi sudut rendah. Varian Kolkhis terbatas pada dragons-in-greek-mythology-c07/c08, tanpa mencampur Ladon berkepala banyak, api atau naga fantasi Barat.
